patch_description: I redesigned the ansatz into a compact alternating ring-cycle structure: a full layer of single-qubit RY rotations, followed by fixed CZ entanglers on disjoint neighboring pairs, then trainable CRY couplings on the complementary shifted pairs. This keeps the circuit shallow and expressive while reducing the per-block parameter count from 28 to 12, improving parameter efficiency and usually helping optimization and generalization without changing the fixed training or readout pipeline.
